why_this_window: The power-on span of the same recording the 2700-3450 fixture windows. It exists so a mid-run window's inherited driver state can be checked against the run that produced it rather than assumed. Its zRingSpeaker history is the first use: the flag is 00h from power-on, flips once at movie row 1436, and is therefore FFh when the CPZ window opens at 2700.

sampling: driver RAM 12FEh..2000h captured by the observer core as a completion snapshot on the driver's own service boundaries, identical in shape and bounds to the other two S2 references.
duplicate_capture: met: two serial captures to distinct absent external paths, byte-identical at sha256 22f36feaa9bbdba5ae0ab97453661d8a45c5622234bb7f82884e1c7c59a238d1
production_bound_meaning: Comparison-only reference data. Nothing here hydrates engine state. The one value the engine side reads from this recording is the count of ring requests before a window, and that comes from the separately published request stimuli rather than from this file.
not_yet_compared: No oracle drives the engine across this span. Doing so needs the engine driver run from power-on through every music load the run performs, and the request producer records no music requests: see the frontier log entry of 2026-09-04 for the two producer limitations found here.
